See the [docs](https://gh.io/AA11tgch) for more details. ## Copilot review overview **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Registers Mistral as a stable `SHELL_POOL` in quota attribution so it can be overlaid by live quota readings (fail-soft behavior) rather than relying on unmapped-pool synthesis, and updates the pool-order test accordingly. **Changes:** - Add a `mistral` entry to `SHELL_POOLS` for stable pool identity. - Update quota pool ordering test expectations to include `mistral`. - Update an explanatory comment in the quota test to reflect the new “every pool renders” framing. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | pm-stack/​aggregator/​test/​quota.test.ts | Updates pool-order assertion and adjusts test commentary to include the new `mistral` pool. | | pm-stack/​aggregator/​src/​quota-extract.ts | Registers `mistral` as a shell pool so live windows can be overlaid onto a stable identity. |
Review effort: Lite
